scope: One fixed-kernel backward-curriculum diagnostic after the completed natural-start learnability failure. No mutant training, model-width sweep, BC comparison, reward change, map change, or horizon change is authorized.
understood_as: First train only from the normal craft-ready state. If that suffix is learned, transfer the full learner checkpoint into a natural-plus-late-start phase. If it is not learned, run only a target-ready mining-and-return localization phase and stop. Every frozen evaluation starts from the original natural state.

fixed_contract.reward: Unchanged discount-consistent potential shaping and fixed normal event rewards from b71c185.
fixed_contract.policy_observation: Unchanged public observation without kernel variant, duplicate provenance, or curriculum-stage label.

stage_a_craft_ready.description: Normal fixed state at the workbench with the two legitimate iron units required for a pickaxe.
stage_a_craft_ready.advance_rule: At least two of three seeds have completed-success fraction >= 0.8 in the final 128 training updates and record positive craft, mine, and return events.
stage_a_craft_ready.claim_limit: This rule chooses the next diagnostic phase. It is not the fixed-task learnability gate.

stage_b_natural_late.condition: Run only if stage A advances.
stage_b_natural_late.initialization: Per seed, transfer policy, critic, Adam, and action RNG from that seed's final stage-A checkpoint; freshly reset environments and local experience counters start the new phase.
stage_b_natural_late.pass_rule: All three final deterministic natural-start policies succeed, and at least two of three final stochastic natural-start success rates are >= 0.8.

fallback_target_ready.condition: Run only if stage A does not advance; stage B is then prohibited.
fallback_target_ready.description: Normal fixed state at the target with a legitimately constructed iron pickaxe.
fallback_target_ready.localization_rule: At least two of three seeds have completed-success fraction >= 0.8 in the final 128 training updates and record positive mine and return events.
fallback_target_ready.claim_limit: This only localizes whether mining-and-return can be learned. It cannot pass the natural-start gate.

maximum_budget.no_result_driven_extension: Stop after stage B or the fallback. Do not add updates, widths, learning rates, reward changes, or horizon changes in this diagnostic.

evaluation_and_leakage.primary_ground_truth: Terminal return of one target mineral from the original natural start under the fixed kernel.
evaluation_and_leakage.training_rollout_metrics: Used only to choose the predeclared branch; never reported as natural-start task success.
evaluation_and_leakage.verifier_designer_limit: The kernel, shaped reward, curriculum, and scorer are project-internal. A pass establishes internal fixed-map learnability under this curriculum, not independent benchmark validity or layout generalization.
evaluation_and_leakage.map_reuse_limit: Training and evaluation share one deterministic map by design; no generalization claim is allowed.

implementation_validation.command: JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu /home/ext_csv/miniconda3/envs/offrl/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_mine_expedition.py tests/test_mine_expedition_env.py tests/test_mine_expedition_gate.py tests/test_mine_expedition_ppo.py tests/test_mine_expedition_curriculum_diagnostic.py
covers: exact craft-ready and target-ready fixed resets
natural-late reset validity without a stage label in the observation
policy, critic, Adam, and action-RNG checkpoint transfer with fresh environment and local counters
training rollout metrics select only the predeclared branch
only stage-B natural-start evaluation can open the fixed gate or authorize future mutant work
the target-ready fallback can localize mining-and-return but cannot authorize mutant training

future_branching: Only after a stage-B natural-start pass may later D-on/D-off conditions be cloned from identical complete learner checkpoints. This diagnostic does not create those branches.

storage.home_policy: Home was 99% utilized with 25,047,605,248 bytes available at launch preparation; all checkpoints remain on RAID.
storage.required_record: Before launch/resume and periodically, record home and RAID capacity, current run bytes, projected remaining checkpoints plus predecessor-successor overlap, evaluation/log allowance, and an >=8 GiB or 20% reserve.
